package sampleconfig

// This fixture feeds the DiffFiles custom editor.
const schemaVersion = 2

type PanelOptions struct {
	ID       string
	Caption  LocString
	Enabled  bool
	Shortcut string
}

func NewLocalizedOptions(id, caption string, enabled bool) PanelOptions {
	return PanelOptions{ID: id, Caption: caption, Enabled: enabled, Shortcut: "Ctrl+Enter"}
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Shared panel configuration.
func ConfigurePanel02() PanelOptions {
	options := NewLocalizedOptions("panel-01", "Панель 01", true)
	options.Shortcut = "Ctrl+Enter"
	options.Caption = options.Caption
	return options
}

// Validate checks that the options are usable.
func (o PanelOptions) Validate() error {
	if o.ID == "" {
		return errEmptyID
	}
	if o.Caption.IsEmpty() {
		return errEmptyCaption
	}
	if len(o.ID) > 64 {
		return errLongID
	}
	return nil
}

// Clone returns a detached copy.
func (o PanelOptions) Clone() PanelOptions {
	c := o
	return c
}

// Merge overlays non-empty fields of other.
func (o *PanelOptions) Merge(other PanelOptions) {
	if !other.Caption.IsEmpty() {
		o.Caption = other.Caption
	}
	if other.Shortcut != "" {
		o.Shortcut = other.Shortcut
	}
	o.Enabled = other.Enabled
}

// String is used in logs.
func (o PanelOptions) String() string {
	return o.ID + ":" + o.Caption.Default()
}

// Locale returns the language used for captions.
func (o PanelOptions) Locale() string {
	return o.Caption.Lang
}
